Own the halls or the GPUs
bottom_line: Power and land sit outside the operator. PLN builds the substations and supplies almost every site, and estates such as GIIC zone and sell the plots. No operator here makes its own power at scale; DCI's 30 MW solar farm in Karawang is the exception.

Operators carry the capital and the customers. DCI, NeutraDC and STT GDC pay for the halls and rent them out. Builders such as Total and Acset are paid per contract, though STT GDC alone was a fifth of Total's 2025 revenue.
In the biggest AI deal, NVIDIA shares the risk. Firmus buys the GPUs for its 360 MW Batam campus, but says NVIDIA gives credit support and takes a share of the cloud revenue.
method: Primary: the company does it, owns it or pays for it, per a source. Shared: it splits that with a named partner, such as a joint venture, a plot bought inside an estate, a building rented from a partner or a revenue share. Limited: it only sells, builds or rents on contract, or no source ties it to that risk.
Every Primary and Shared cell opens the filing or company page it rests on, with the quoted line. Limited cells carry a source only when one says what the company does instead.
The ten columns are companies on this page with the most sourced ties, two or more per role. The levels are our reading of those sources, checked 17 Oct 2026.

Most figures come from the companies' own annual reports and statements (DCI, Total Bangun Persada, Acset, PT PP, Puradelta Lestari, Telkom), their releases (Firmus, STT GDC, Digital Edge) and PLN's statements. "Company's word" marks a claim only that company has made.
